jobs.snippet:
Bagira is a leader in the field of training and simulation systems worldwide, is seeking an experienced Construction Project Manager to lead the end-to-end design and construction of simulation sites in Israel and abroad.
This hands-on role combines architectural and infrastructure planning, drafting, project management, contractor coordination, and on-site supervision-from initial requirements through site handover and readiness for system installation.
Manage simulation-site construction projects from requirements definition and planning through execution, commissioning, and handover.
Translate technical and operational system requirements into construction, layout, and infrastructure plans.
Prepare site layouts, construction drawings, and detailed plans using AutoCAD.
Plan and coordinate site requirements, including electrical systems, communications, HVAC, lighting, acoustics, safety, accessibility, and related infrastructure.
Prepare and manage contractor tender documents, evaluate bids, and support the contractor selection process.
Coordinate and manage architects, structural engineers, professional consultants, contractors, and suppliers.
Develop and monitor project schedules, budgets, work plans, and milestones.
Supervise on-site construction activities and ensure compliance with approved plans, technical requirements, quality standards, schedules, and budgets.
Identify design and execution gaps and provide practical solutions during construction.
Conduct inspections, manage punch lists, and follow up on corrective work.
Ensure site readiness for the installation, integration, and commissioning of simulation systems. Collaborate with internal engineering, technical, operational, and project teams, as well as customers and local partners in Israel and abroad.
Take full responsibility for obtaining all required occupancy permits, approvals, certificates, “as made” drawing package, and sign-offs from professional engineers and the relevant authorities prior to project completion and handover.
Requirements:
B.Sc. in Civil Engineering or Architecture, or a relevant practical engineering qualification.
Up to 5 years of hands-on experience in on-site supervision of construction projects, from initial planning through completion and handover.
Experience in the design, construction, and on-site supervision of similar facilities abroad-such as simulation sites, training centers, control rooms, technology-intensive facilities, or defence facilities-an advantage.
Proficiency in AutoCAD, including the preparation of site layouts, construction drawings, and detailed execution plans.
Proven experience coordinating architectural, construction, and infrastructure plans and working with contractors, suppliers, engineers, architects, and professional consultants.
Experience preparing and reviewing technical specifications, bills of quantities, cost estimates, project schedules, and contractor proposals.
Strong project management capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple projects, stakeholders, budgets, schedules, and priorities independently.
High-level English, including the ability to work with technical documentation and communicate in an international environment.
Willingness to travel to project sites in Israel and abroad.
Valid driving licence and access to a private vehicle.

jobs.snippet:
About the job
Field Service Engineer (FSE) Job description:
responsible for providing on-site support, maintenance, and repair services for the multi-disciplinary, high-accuracy ultrasound scanners provided by ScanMaster worldwide.
Key Responsibilities and Duties
Installation and Commissioning: Traveling to customer sites to install, configure, calibrate, and test new or existing equipment and systems, ensuring they operate correctly and are set up.
Troubleshooting and Repair: Diagnosing and resolving complex mechanical, electrical, or software issues with existing equipment, in response to service calls. This involves using specialized tools and interpreting technical schematics.
Preventive Maintenance: Performing scheduled maintenance, inspections, and upgrades to ensure long-term reliability and prevent future malfunctions.
Technical Support and Training: Providing customers with technical guidance, answering product-related questions, and training end-users (and/or agents) in the proper operation and basic maintenance of the equipment.
Mechanic Geometrical Measurements: Performing mechanical geometrical measurements for UT systems includes implementing a 3D laser & correction table, or using Granit with a dial indicator.
UT Electronic Calibration: Performing Electronic (RF Amplitude and Signal) Measurements on the company UT equipment, the UPR/RPP, using Scoop Analyser, Signal Generator & Attenuator.
Documentation and Reporting: Maintaining detailed records of all service activities, including repairs performed (Service Calls), parts consumed, time spent, and system performance.
Customer Communication: Acting as a primary technical point of contact, communicating effectively with customers regarding service status, technical issues, recommendations, and billing.
Required Skills and Qualifications:
Technical Skills
Education: BSc in engineering (e.g., Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, or related field), Practical engineer or a relevant associate’s degree/vocational certificate.
Technical Aptitude: Experienced in working with multi-disciplinary systems, including mechanical, electrical, and electronic systems, circuitry, and software/PLC’s (Programmable Logic Controllers), MS Office, CAD tools.

jobs.snippet:
Kela is a defense technology startup pioneering next-generation defense technology, from command & control software to complete field-deployed systems. We empower defense organizations with robust, scalable, and secure platforms that integrate diverse sensors and AI to deliver real-time battlefield intelligence. Backed by leading investors, Kela combines Israeli innovation with global mission impact.
We move faster than any defense startup you've worked at, and faster than most commercial ones. Prototypes go from sketch to metal in weeks, not quarters. If that pace sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.
Requirements:
We are looking for a hands-on Field Operations Specialist to own the operational preparation, coordination and execution of flight tests, demonstrations and field activities for drone systems.
The role combines office work and fieldwork, with the balance changing according to company needs, including periods of intensive field activity. All activities take place in Israel.
Responsibilities
Prepare operational readiness plans and execute field activities according to agreed plans and priorities.
Coordinate requirements and resources with development teams, engineers, drone operators and external partners.
Ensure activity sites, equipment, vehicles and infrastructure are ready. Track preparation tasks, identify gaps and drive solutions.
Coordinate transport, equipment and supplies with Logistics and Procurement, with purchasing and warehouse management handled by those teams.
Set up, connect, deploy and operate drone systems and supporting equipment, including ground equipment, communications systems, batteries and control equipment.
Perform checks before and after activities according to procedures, pack down equipment and prepare it for further use.
Provide operational and technical support during flight tests and demonstrations. Troubleshoot basic faults and work with engineering and development teams to resolve complex issues.
Create and maintain procedures and checklists. Document activities, faults and operational gaps, capture lessons learned and follow through on improvements and outstanding tasks.
Requirements
2–4 years of relevant experience in field operations, systems operations or a similar technical operations role. Relevant military experience is fully recognized as equivalent to civilian experience.
Strong planning, organization and coordination skills, with the ability to manage tasks across multiple teams.
Technical aptitude and hands-on experience setting up and operating equipment, performing checks and troubleshooting basic faults.
Independence, initiative and personal ownership, with the ability to drive tasks through to completion.
Strong attention to detail, adaptability and resourcefulness when solving problems in the field.
Good interpersonal skills, a collaborative approach and a willingness to learn and develop.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
Good English proficiency.
A valid driving license.
Willingness to perform hands-on fieldwork throughout Israel, including intensive periods and variable working hours.
Advantages
Experience flying drones or operating UAV/UAS systems.
A relevant drone pilot license or certification.
Experience preparing for and supporting flight tests.
Experience in the technology or defense industry, or military experience operating technical systems or coordinating field operations.
Familiarity with command and control systems, communications systems and ground equipment.
A degree in Industrial Engineering and Management, Engineering or a related field.

About ASIO
ASIO develops combat-proven systems that empower tactical forces at the edge. Combining advanced technology with operational simplicity, our solutions support mission planning, situational awareness, resilient navigation, and more, enabling battalions to operate independently and achieve mission success.
02 BEARING
The Opportunity
We are looking for an Integrator to join the LYNX department's integration team, supporting the development of integrated electro-optical products. This is a hands-on role that combines work in the integration lab, field trials simulating a platoon-based military environment, and customer demonstrations in Israel and abroad.
03 WAYPOINTS
Key Responsibilities
01          Integration and development support: Join the integration team and support the development of integrated electro-optical products, conduct system tests required to support field deployment.
02          Integration, installation and testing: Perform integrations, installation, and configuration of the integrated systems, and carry out Acceptance Test Procedures, fault investigations, and calibrations.
03          V&V support: Support the product's V&V efforts, and improve transfer to production process and ATP testing throughout FULL PRODUCTION.
04          Cross-functional collaboration: Work with development, systems, and engineering teams, as well as with marketing and customers.
05          Demonstrations and training: take part in customer demonstrations in Israel and abroad, be involved in product training across various end users.
06          office and field work: Work on an ongoing basis in the integration lab, alongside work in test fields that simulate a platoon-based military environment.
Requirements:
04 CALIBRATION
What You Bring
+            At least Two years of Techno / operational experience in the military.
+           Intimate familiarity with IDF OLAR device
+             Technical background (technician / operator) with electro-optics devices, electronics, or electromechanics.
+             Ability to identify and analyze problems in complex systems – hardware, software, and optics.
05 SIGNAL_BOOST
Strong Advantages
+            Combat experience as an operational technician of electro-optical systems – a significant advantage.
+            Experience working with complex systems and perform dedicated tests for hardware software and optics, and producing analysis reports.
+            Good familiarity with computer and Android applications.
06 TRUE_NORTH
Why Join ASIO?
Make a real operational impact: Help bring advanced technologies to defense forces operating in the most demanding environments.
Turn innovation into mission capability: Experience cutting-edge technology with real-world operational needs.
Build strategic relationships: Work directly with senior Multidisciplinary experience engineers across significant ecosystem.
Own the journey from opportunity to impact: Join a collaborative, fast-moving team where initiative, accountability, and execution matter.

We’re Hiring: Plant Operations Technician
Looking for a hands-on, technically minded person who is eager to learn and grow 🚀
A growing startup transforming industrial waste into oil for Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) production, looking for a Plant Operations Technician to join our team at our facility in Ofakim, Israel.
The role includes:
* Operating the facility and its equipment.
* Monitoring the production process.
* Handling operational issues and troubleshooting.
* Working closely with our engineering team.
Who are we looking for?
Someone with a technical background, experience operating industrial facilities or wastewater treatment plants, a practical engineering diploma, or simply a strong interest in working with systems and equipment.
We value responsibility, initiative, curiosity, and above all, a willingness to learn and grow.
This is an opportunity to grow with the company and take on additional responsibilities based on your skills, initiative, and development.
Interested? Know someone who might be a good fit?
Send your CV to: Office@naki-v.com

רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
מיקום: עיקר הפעילות באתרי פרויקטים באזור המרכז.
ניידות: חובה: רישיון לדו-גלגלי ונכונות לעבודה שוטפת על קטנוע/אופנוע.
** החברה תספק דו-גלגלי איכותי למתאימים!
תחומי אחריות:
* אינטגרציה, כיול והרצה (Commissioning) של מערכות אוטומטיות ואלקטרומכניות מורכבות בשטח.
* אבחון ותיקון תקלות (Troubleshooting) ברשתות תקשורת, בקרים ומערכות חשמל.
* ביצוע התאמות פיזיות, שינויים ושיפורי התקנה באמצעות כלי עבודה ידניים וחשמליים.
דרישות התפקיד
* אינטגרציית שטח: ניסיון מעשי מוכח של שנתיים לפחות בסינכרון והרצת מערכות טכנולוגיות בשטח.
* חשמל: הבנה מעמיקה וניסיון מעשי מוכח במערכות מתח נמוך ומתח גבוה (לא נדרשת תעודה, חובה ידע טכני מוכח).
* חוש טכני: ניסיון מעשי מוכח בעבודה עם כלי עבודה מכאניים לביצוע התאמות ושינויים מבניים בשטח.
* תוכנה ושפות: שליטה מלאה במחשב ובתוכנות תקשורת, קריאת דפי נתונים (Datasheets) ואנגלית טכנית ברמה גבוהה.
* קריאת שרטוטים: הבנה מלאה בקריאת תוכניות חשמל/מכאניקה.
יתרונות משמעותיים:
* ידע ב-CODESYS (ברמת Debug ואיתור תקלות).

jobs.snippet:
Who We Are
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
What We Offer
Location:
Mig Ha'emek,ISR
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
Key Responsibilities
Performs standard Tier I procedures including wafer measurement.
Performs preventative maintenance and wet cleans independently. Assists senior engineers with corrective maintenance as needed.
Disassembles, cleans and rebuilds kits as part of kit management quality.
Learns and applies diagnostic techniques and use of documentation and test equipment with assistance from senior engineers.
Able to diagnose and resolve basic technical problems.
Strives to perform BKM’s. Uses knowledge management systems. Follows all IP guidelines.
Has the ability to represent Applied Materials to the customer. Uses good customer service skills at all times while maintaining a professional demeanor. Displays respect for the customer by maintaining a neat and orderly work area. Demonstrates a positive attitude in less than optimal customer situations.
Complies with all safety procedures and consistently demonstrates safety as a value.
Other Requirements
: This is a physically demanding position that often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools. Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.
Functional Knowledge
Has developed analytical skills and application of scientific methods to perform a variety of activities
Business Expertise
Has good understanding of how the team integrates with others
Leadership
Has no supervisory responsibilities
Problem Solving
Recognizes and solves typical problems that can occur in own work area without supervisory approval; evaluates and selects solutions from established operating procedures and/or scientific methods
Impact
Impacts the quality of own work
Interpersonal Skills
Uses communication skills to exchange of information
Additional Information

Full time
Employee Type:
Assignee / Regular
Travel:
Yes, 10% of the Time
Relocation Eligible:
No

jobs.snippet:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
Maintenance Operator
Purpose of the job
- The Maintenance Operator is responsible to service, maintain, perform maintenace repairs of the overhead contcat system (OCS) , Transformers stations (TS) and Infrastructure equipment. As part of the maintenance team, they will ensure the equipment is serviced and maintained in a safe, efficient and cost effective manner whilst constantly seeking to improve quality.
Responsibilities
Maintenance
- Work as directed by and in co-operation with the Team Leaders and Production Management Team in order to:-- Adhere to and work within Quality Systems to the current applicable standards.- Work as part of a team, complete or assist in any of the team's activities to ensure work is completed on time to specification.- Understand and follow work instructions, Standard Operating Sheets and Task Sequencing.- Apply Special Processes.- Support secondary level fault finding as and when required.- Use work related IT Systems as required including MMIS/SES to record progress of operations and status of issues.
Reporting
- Accurately report status of operations, complete Work Checklists and Work Orders with the required level of detail including completion time.
Continuous Improvement
- Make suggestions and recommendations for productivity improvements working with the team leaders and Industrial Team.- Maintain 5S good housekeeping of all related work areas in accordance with set standards.
Training/Agility
- Be capable of accepting training in other skills and carry out duties, e.g. forklift, road vehicle driving (if certified), attend call-outs and breakdowns if required.- Be capable of being re-trained in other activities/skills as required by the Production Management Team in order to support the Operations as required.
EHS
- Understand and abide to safety notices, rules and regulations and follow safe working practices compliant with local standards.- Comply with all EHS protection and AZDP measures.
Educational Requirements
- Time served apprenticeship or equivalent with associated technical qualifications (ONC/HNC/City & Guilds) or recognised equivalent- Dual skilled (mechanical and electrical)- Electrical certified Principal engineer- Advantage for Electrical certified in Medium Voltage
Desired Knowledge / Experience
- Experience of working to procedures, work instructions and vehicle maintenance instructions- Knowledge, and practical experience of train maintenance- Experience of mentoring and instructing other team members - Technical skills in fault finding, reading schematic diagrams, work to technical instructions- Languages : Country language and English fluent.
Behavioural Competencies
- Team Player. Spirit of “Team Trust Action”- Good written and verbal communication skills- Problem resolution skills- Self-motivated- Ability to work under own initiative- IT literate
You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
Important to note
As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

jobs.snippet:
Description -
We are looking for an
experienced Integrator
to join our production line for industrial digital printing machines.
This role involves working in a multidisciplinary environment, integrating, maintaining, and troubleshooting advanced printing systems that include mechanical, electrical, electronic, laser, and pneumatic components.
If you have strong technical capabilities, a creative mindset, and the ability to solve problems in real time - we would love to hear from you.
Key Responsibilities
Perform complex integration and assembly processes on industrial digital printing machines within the production line
Troubleshoot and resolve real-time issues across multidisciplinary systems (mechanical, electrical, electronic, pneumatic, and laser)
Disassemble and reassemble components for repair and maintenance purposes
Document failures and write detailed technical reports on troubleshooting processes and implemented solutions
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Quality, and Logistics to improve processes and ensure smooth operations
Use advanced diagnostic tools and technical equipment to identify and resolve system issues
Requirements
Proven experience working in a production line environment, preferably with multidisciplinary systems
Hands-on knowledge in the following areas: electrical systems, electronics, mechanics, laser, and pneumatics
Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and electrical schematics
Experience writing technical reports and documenting issues – mandatory
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure
Excellent teamwork and interpersonal skills with the ability to work across multiple interfaces
Education
Technician / Practical Engineer degree in relevant fields (Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Instrumentation & Control)

Nice to meet you - we are Kornit Digital!
Kornit Digital is a worldwide market leader in sustainable, on-demand, digital fashion and textile production technologies. The Company is writing the operating system for fashion with end-to-end solutions including digital printing systems, inks, consumables, and an entire global ecosystem that manages workflows and fulfilment.
Every day we take the chance to re-invent, create, solve, adapt, improve and conquer the unexpected. Our engagement drives us to change the way people print on textiles today and in the future.
You are invited to be part of it to #expressyourbest!
Click to learn more > www.kornit.com
What you can expect:
We reward - attractive compensation package and profit sharing in shareholder program
We celebrate – global company events global wellness program
The chance to drive your own success story in an internationally successful company with sustainable prospects for the future
Open corporate culture with a team-oriented transfer of know-how
Variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training through the Kornit Academy in a truly global landscape
Flexible working hours with home office regulation
What will you do?
We are looking for a highly hands-on, technically oriented individual to join the team as a
Testing Center Technical Specialist
, while also supporting our
New Product Introduction (NPI) field activities
.
Testing Center Technical Specialist – Primary Focus
The primary focus of the position will be to support the technical operation of the Testing Center, including:
Perform daily maintenance and technical support of Kornit equipment in the Testing Center.
Operate Kornit systems during Alpha testing.
Support the technical aspects of the Testing Center’s daily activities.
Ensure systems are available and ready to support planned testing activities.
NPI Field Support
In parallel, we want to strengthen the connection between product development, internal testing, and the reality of customer production environments.
The position includes
up to 50% travel and work at customer sites
, mainly during the first half of 2027. The goal is to gain first-hand understanding of customer workflows, operational challenges, system behavior, and real production conditions.
This field exposure will allow the team to bring real-time information and insights from challenging customer environments into NPI activities, improving our ability to identify gaps, validate solutions, and represent the customer's perspective.
Key Responsibilities
Take responsibility for the technical aspects of the Testing Center’s daily routines and equipment.
Operate Kornit systems during Alpha testing.
Participate in and support NPI activities, including Alpha/Beta activities, product validation, testing, issue investigation, and readiness assessment.
Work directly at customer sites to monitor systems and production workflows under real operating conditions.
Travel up to 50% of the time, including international travel when required, particularly during the first half of 2027.
Develop a strong understanding of customer pain points, workflows, operational constraints, and production requirements.
Perform hands-on technical activities on systems, including troubleshooting, testing, configuration, data collection, and problem reproduction.
Identify and document issues that may not be visible through standard system logs or remote monitoring tools.
Translate field observations into clear technical findings and actionable feedback for R&D, Product, Service, Application, and other relevant stakeholders.
Support troubleshooting and root-cause analysis activities together with technical teams.
Participate in customer-site activities related to new products, upgrades, validations, pilots, and Beta installations.
Requirements:
What should you have?
Highly hands-on and technically oriented – comfortable working directly with machines, hardware, software, and production environments.
A strong troubleshooter with a systematic approach to problem solving and root-cause investigation.
Comfortable working independently at customer sites and taking ownership of technical activities.
Willing and able to travel up to 50% of the time, particularly during periods of intensive NPI field activity.
Comfortable interacting directly with customers and production teams.
Curious and proactive, with a strong desire to understand not only what happened, but also why it happened.
Able to observe customer workflows and identify gaps between expected product behavior and real-world usage.
Capable of collecting, organizing, documenting, and communicating technical information clearly.
Able to work effectively across multiple functions, including R&D, Product, Application, Customer Success, Service, and Operations.
Able to operate effectively in dynamic environments where priorities may change according to NPI, Testing Center, and customer needs.
Advantage
The following experience would be considered an advantage, but is
not mandatory
:
Previous experience in Kornit's application areas or digital printing environments.
Experience with Kornit systems and production workflows.
Field Service, Application, Engineering, Integration, Validation, or technical Customer Success experience.
Experience supporting Alpha/Beta installations or NPI programs.
Experience with data collection, system logs, monitoring tools, and technical analysis.
Understanding of industrial production environments and customer production processes.
Personal Characteristics
We are looking for someone who combines
strong technical capabilities with a field-oriented mindset
.
The candidate should be:
Hands-on and practical
Technically curious
Customer-oriented
Independent and accountable
Comfortable working under pressure
Analytical and methodical
A strong communicator
Flexible and willing to travel
Comfortable moving between laboratory/testing environments and real customer production floors
Don't check all the boxes? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes in our passionate -and-fun, remote-friendly, fast paced environment—apply anyway. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.
KORNIT is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. We are committed to ensuring that our technology is made available and accessible to everyone. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.snippet:
About The Role
Starbird is a Tel Aviv-based startup building GPS-independent positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) technology for defense and civilian markets. You will join a growing company working on new and exciting technology.
We are looking for a Field Test & Integration Engineer at the start of their career to run trials of our systems and integrate them with customers and in-house. This is a long-term role: over time you will lead trials, deploy systems in the field and work with customers after the sale.
Location: Tel Aviv
Scope: Full-time
What You'll Do
Plan and run field trials of our systems, collect the data and write trial reports.
Install and integrate our systems on customer platforms, and support customers during their trials.
Support product evaluations, demos, and customer field trials.
Provide user training and operational support for deployed units.
Build and maintain test setups in our lab, and run checks before each trial.
Analyze trial results with R&D and bring field feedback back to the team.
Write test procedures and installation guides.
Requirements
Strong technical sense and a hands-on approach.
High motivation and a wish to grow with the company over the long term.
Fluent English, written and spoken.
Valid driving license and readiness for field work.
Advantages
Technical background: engineering studies, a practical engineering diploma or a technical role in military service.
Hands-on experience with drones, electronics or RF equipment.
Basic scripting (e.g., Python).
Customer-facing experience.

jobs.snippet:
Field Application Engineer
System Integration | Product Deployment | Technical Support
We're looking for an experienced, hands-on Field Application Engineer to lead integration, deployment, and technical support of an exciting, multidisciplinary Physical AI product.
Join a well-established startup developing advanced mechatronic systems combining mechanics, motion control, electronics, and intelligent software.
The challenge:
•            Lead system integration, bring-up, installation, and commissioning.
•            Troubleshoot complex mechanical, electrical, and software issues.
•            Support product deployment at customer sites worldwide.
•            Work closely with R&D to improve product reliability and performance.
•            Representing the company professionally in the field.
What you bring:
•            Proven experience in system integration, field applications, or multidisciplinary engineering.
•            Strong technical understanding and hands-on troubleshooting skills.
•            Excellent communication, interpersonal skills, and customer orientation.
•            Independent, practical, and solution-oriented approach.
•            Good English and willingness to travel internationally.
•            BSc in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field is an advantage.
Above all, we value strong engineering skills, product understanding, and the ability to make things work.

במסגרת הגשת המועמדות למכרז כוח אדם, חברת הגיחון אוספת מידע אישי על המועמד, לרבות פרטי זיהוי וקשר, קורות חיים, השכלה, ניסיון מקצועי, המלצות ומידע הנמסר במסגרת הליך המיון. מסירת המידע תלויה ברצונו של המועמד, אולם ללא מסירת המידע הנדרש לא ניתן יהיה לבחון את מועמדותו. המידע ישמש לצורך ניהול הליך המכרז, בחינת ההתאמה לתפקיד, קבלת החלטה ותיעוד ההליך, ועשוי להימסר לחברי ועדת המכרזים, לספקי מיון והשמה הפועלים מטעם חברת הגיחון ולגורמים המוסמכים לקבלו לפי דין. המידע יישמר בהתאם להוראות הדין ולמדיניות חברת הגיחון. המועמד רשאי לבקש לעיין במידע עליו ולתקנו בהתאם לחוק הגנת הפרטיות באמצעות פנייה

jobs.snippet:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
PURPOSE OF THE JOB:
The Power Supply T&C Technician is responsible for executing all Test & Commissioning activities related to power supply systems at the project site. The role ensures that all equipment and systems are installed, tested, and commissioned in accordance with engineering specifications, safety standards, and project requirements.
MAIN RESPONSABILITIES :
Key Accountabilities:
Execute on-site testing and commissioning of power supply systems (MV/LV equipment, traction systems, transformers, protection systems, control and automation).
Perform functional tests, insulation/megger tests, continuity checks, torque verifications, and panel energization procedures.
Ensure compliance with engineering documentation, FAT/SAT procedures, technical standards, and QCD criteria.
Clear and Exhaustive understanding of the Customer Acceptance Criteria.
Manage the development and supply of test procedures, facilities and tools for RS sites and depots
Ensure that test procedures and tools configuration are managed during the project lifecycle
Define the Standard Operating Procedures with reference time and monitor deviations
Continuously optimizing SOP’s.
Implement REX (Return of Experience) from Test & Commissioning phase of the project.
Ensure Interface and perfect working relationship with engineering project team, Site Industrial, Warranty Implementation team, Site Logistics and Industrial Support to Warranty teams, Quality, Site Validation team.
Support the T&C Operations team, for the implementation and execution of the Testing Procedures.
Implement and deploy methods and tools and best practices pointed out at group level.
Provide technical support to installation and site teams regarding electrical design issues, system interfaces, and test readiness.
Coordinate with Power Supply Engineering, Project Management, Suppliers, Subcontractors, and Field Operations teams.
Participate in troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and corrective action implementation.
Prepare test procedures, checklists, T&C reports, NCRs, and as-built test documentation.
Ensure proper configuration management and version control of T&C documents.
Submit T&C deliverables for approval according to project quality requirements.
Ensure all site activities comply with EHS standards, electrical work regulations, and client requirements.
Participate in site safety briefings, toolbox talks, and risk assessments.
MAIN REQUIRED COMPETENCES:
Educational Requirements:
Mandatory:
Practical Engineer/ Technician in Electrical Engineering or related field.
Valid electrical work license “Electrical Practical Engineer “/ ” Electrical Technician”
Driver License
Strong communication, autonomy, rigor, and safety mindset.
Good knowledge of English language (read, written, spoken).
Desirable:
Railway and Power supply systems knowledge
Any other additional language is an asset
Experience:
Mandatory:
Minimum 2-3 years’ experience in Testing & Commissioning of Electrical, Control, onboard communications & network systems within process industry, railways or factory automation
Strong knowledge of MV/LV systems, traction power, substations, control panels, and electrical commissioning.
Hands-on experience with instrumentation, testing methods, and diagnostic tools.
Ability to interpret electrical schematics, SLDs, protection diagrams, and installation drawings.
Excellent communication, autonomy, and problem-solving abilities.
Fluent in English language
Competencies & Skills
Have a good technical level in electrical, electronic, mechanical and networks domains
Understanding of Lean approach for Industrialization
Result-driven mindset
Ability to foster communications between multiple stakeholders (product engineering, manufacturing engineering, industrial functions…)
Ability for problem-solving and efficient decision-making in complex environment

jobs.snippet:
About the Role
Lowental Hybrid is looking for an Engine Technician to join its engineering team. In this hands-on role, you will build and assemble engines and hybrid propulsion systems for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), prepare them for testing, conduct ground runs and acceptance tests, and maintain the engine test cell.
You will work closely with mechanical and electrical engineers, helping turn designs into hardware and verify how it performs in the test cell.
Responsibilities
Assemble engines and install them in the test cell.
Carry out engine runs and tests in accordance with test procedures.
Troubleshoot faults and perform routine maintenance on engines and the test cell.
Document engine runs and follow safety procedures.
Minimum Qualifications
Training as an automotive or aircraft mechanic, or equivalent technical training.
Ability to read engineering drawings and use measuring tools.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with UAV engines or two-stroke engines.
Experience working in an engine test cell or with a dynamometer.
Familiarity with electronic fuel injection (EFI) and basic electrical systems.
Personal Skills
Strong hands-on skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Commitment to safe working practices.
Employment Details
Full-time position reporting to the Mechanical Team Lead.
The position is open to applicants of all genders.

Job Description Summary
Bietet Know-how für nachhaltigen Kundenerfolg und Wachstum im Post-Sales-Kundenlebenszyklus durch Schulung, professionellen Service, technischen Support, Verlängerungen, Erreichung von Ergebnissen, Bindung, Erweiterung und Kundenbetreuung mit digitalem Fokus. Verantwortlich für die Planung/Ausführung des Abteilungsbetriebs oder konzentriert sich auf die Ausführung von beruflichen Tätigkeiten innerhalb einer technischen Disziplin.Hat eine gewisse Autonomie, wird jedoch von festgelegten Richtlinien oder der Überprüfung der Endergebnisse geleitet.
Die Stelle ermöglicht die Änderung von Arbeitsabläufen und Praktiken, sofern die Endergebnisse den Standards der Akzeptanz (Qualität, Umfang, Aktualität usw.) entsprechen.
Job Description
Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten
Tragen zur Implementierung von MES-Lösungen unter Verwendung der Software-Suite bei. Übernehmen während des gesamten Lebenszyklus der Projekte die Verantwortung für technische Leistungen. Beteiligen sich während des gesamten Lebenszyklus von zugewiesenen Projekten an Entscheidungen bezüglich Architektur, Design und Funktionalität, um Programme hinsichtlich Budget, Zeit und Kundenerwartungen innerhalb des vorgegebenen Rahmens zu halten. Arbeiten eng mit dem Kunden zusammen, um dessen Bedürfnisse zu verstehen und Strategien zu entwickeln, die mittels Standortbewertungen auf seine Organisation zugeschnitten sind. Geben zudem während des Implementierungsprozesses gegenüber Kunden Standardempfehlungen zu Workflow, Anwendung, Benutzeroberfläche, Berichten, Tests und Uploads ab. Tragen die Verantwortung für die Bereitschaft und den Support für die Inbetriebnahme sowie für die Nachuntersuchungen und müssen mit internen Teammitgliedern und Kunden zusammenarbeiten, um die Kundenzufriedenheit zu gewährleisten
Nutzt vertiefte Kenntnisse einer technischen Disziplin sowie analytisches Denken und technische Erfahrung zur Umsetzung von Richtlinien/Strategien.
Hat Kenntnisse über Best Practices und darüber, wie sich der eigene Bereich in andere integriert; ist sich des Wettbewerbs und der Faktoren bewusst, die das Unternehmen auf dem Markt auszeichnen
Nutzt ein gewisses Urteilsvermögen und hat die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Lösungen außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter vorzuschlagen, um kompliziertere Herstellungsprozesse mit technischer Vielfalt und/oder voneinander abhängigen Produktionszyklen anzugehen.Verwendet technische Erfahrung und analytisches Denken.Verwendet mehrere interne und begrenzte externe Quellen außerhalb der eigenen Teams, um Entscheidungen zu treffen.
Dient als Ressource für Kollegen mit weniger Erfahrung.Kann kleine Projekte mit geringen Risiken und Ressourcenanforderungen leiten.Erklärt Informationen; Entwicklung von Fähigkeiten, um Teammitglieder zu einem Konsens über Themen innerhalb des Feldes zu bewegen.Vermittelt Leistungserwartungen und kann vertrauliche Themen behandeln.
Grundqualifikationen
Diese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit relevanter Erfahrung).
Gewünschte Eigenschaften
Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, andere zu beeinflussen und kleine Teams zu führen. Initiativen von mittlerem Umfang und mittlerer Wirkung leiten. Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu koordinieren. Effektive Erkennung und Lösung von Problemen. Nachweisliche analytische und organisatorische Fähigkeiten.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.
Additional Information
The job is open to men and women equally

jobs.snippet:
Who We Are
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
What We Offer
Location:
Mig Ha'emek,ISR
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.
Job Description
We are looking for a highly talented customer engineer to join our account team & integrate within our field support group in
Migdal Haemek
to provide a unique customer experience by demonstrating outstanding technical capabilities and inter-personal skills.
What’s in it for you?
As a customer engineer at Applied Materials you’ll be working for a high growth international company, integrating into the heart of the manufacturing process of advanced digital devices. You’ll get the opportunity and practice to work on the most advanced semiconductor equipment while learning new skills or perfecting existing ones such as advanced trouble shooting and problem solving, project management, robotics, semiconductor device manufacturing processes and more. In addition, you’ll get advanced training on cutting edge hardware industry components.
Role Responsibilities:
Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] in installing, maintaining, and upgrading customer equipment
Use digital analytics for troubleshooting
Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with guidance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems (training provided)
Coordinate and communicate directly with customers
Fulfill additional duties, as assigned
Minimum Qualifications:
B.Sc. or Practical Engineer in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering , field service experience, or trade certification
Willing to learn and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics
Experience diagnosing and resolving basic technical challenges
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.
Preferred Qualifications:
1–2 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field
Associate degree in electronics or engineering technologies
Knowledge of pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, or thermodynamics
Familiarity with hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters
Work is located in Migdal Haemek in a cleanroom environment
Work in shifts including nights and weekends
Physical Requirements:
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools. Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.
Additional Information
Time Type:
Full time
Employee Type:
Assignee / Regular
Travel:
Yes, 20% of the Time
Relocation Eligible:
No
Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

jobs.snippet:
Ready to bridge the gap between IT infrastructure and industrial operations?
We’re looking for an
IT/OT & Infrastructure Project Manager
to lead technology projects across manufacturing facilities for a leading nationwide organization.
This role combines hands-on technical understanding of IT and OT environments with project leadership, infrastructure planning, cybersecurity, and collaboration with diverse stakeholders.
What will you do?
Lead IT/OT infrastructure projects across the company’s manufacturing facilities.
Identify and address infrastructure and cybersecurity gaps in production environments.
Support the implementation of new equipment and production lines.
Plan infrastructure and integrate industrial equipment into OT networks.
Work closely with maintenance managers, technical managers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.
Collaborate with international suppliers, leading technical discussions in English and driving alignment across teams.
What are we looking for?
3+ years of experience working with PLCs, industrial communication protocols, and HMI/SCADA systems.
Experience with IT infrastructure, including networking, cybersecurity, systems administration, and operating systems.
Experience working in a manufacturing environment or on a production floor within a large organization.
Experience planning infrastructure and integrating equipment into OT networks.
Fluent English – mandatory.
Advantages
Familiarity with Siemens, Allen-Bradley, or Unitronics.
Experience with System Platform and Cimplicity.
Knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as Profinet, EtherNet/IP, Modbus, and BACnet.
📍
Location:
Petah Tikva, Israel
🏠
Work Model:
Hybrid, including travel to company manufacturing facilities.
Interested in leading projects at the intersection of IT, OT, and industrial infrastructure? We’d love to hear from you!

jobs.snippet:
מהות התפקיד:
אחריות על הכנת הצעות מסחריות וטכניות לפרויקטי אנרגיה, בדגש על PV, BESS ותשתיות חשמל, משלב קבלת ה־RFP/מכרז ועד להגשת הצעה מלאה.
התפקיד משלב הבנה הנדסית, תכנון קונספטואלי, תמחור, עבודה מול ספקים וקבלני משנה וניתוח סיכונים מסחריים וטכניים.
תחומי אחריות מרכזיים:
·        ניהול תהליך ה־Bid מקבלת המכרז/RFP ועד להגשת ההצעה.
·        לימוד מסמכי המכרז, מפרטים, SLD, תוכניות, דרישות חיבור והגדרת Scope of Work.
·        הכנת Concept / Preliminary Design לצורך תמחור – העמדת ציוד, Layout ראשוני, בחירת קונפיגורציה והגדרת פתרון הנדסי.
·        הכנת BOQ / BOM ואומדן כמויות.
·        תמחור CAPEX לפרויקט: ציוד עיקרי, עבודות חשמל ואזרחיות, MV/HV, כבלים, תחנות משנה, SCADA/EMS, תקשורת, הקמה, בדיקות ו־Commissioning.
·        קבלת הצעות מחיר מספקים וקבלני משנה, השוואת הצעות וניהול הבהרות טכניות ומסחריות.
·        היכרות שוטפת עם מחירי השוק, ספקים, קבלנים וטכנולוגיות בתחום האנרגיה.
·       הכנת Cost Breakdown, תקציב בסיס ו־Tender Summary לאישור הנהלה.
·        עבודה משותפת עם המחלקות השונות (משפטי, רכש, הנדסה, כספים).
·        ביצוע Bid-to-Execution Handover מסודר למנהל הפרויקט לאחר זכייה, כולל העברת התקציב, ההנחות, ההתחייבויות והסיכונים שעל בסיסם הוגשה ההצעה.
·        בנייה ועדכון של מאגר מחירים ו־Cost Database ארגוני המבוסס על הצעות ופרויקטים שבוצעו בפועל.
·        ביצוע Post-Bid / Post-Project analysis – השוואת התמחור המקורי לעלות בפועל והפקת לקחים להצעות הבאות.
דרישות התפקיד
חובה:
·        מהנדס/ת ו/או הנדסאי מכונות/חשמל מעולם האנרגיה.
·        לפחות 3 שנות ניסיון בתחום האנרגיה/תשתיות חשמל.
·        ניסיון בפרויקטי PV ו/או BESS – עדיפות משמעותית לניסיון בשניהם.
·        ניסיון בתמחור, מכרזים, Engineering או Project Engineering בפרויקטי EPC.
·        יכולת לקרוא ולהבין SLD, מפרטים טכניים, Layouts ותוכניות.
·        יכולת לבצע תכנון קונספטואלי/ראשוני והעמדת ציוד לצורך בניית פתרון ותמחור.
·        הבנה טובה של ציוד מרכזי: PV modules, inverters/PCS, BESS, transformers, MV/HV switchgear, cables, SCADA/EMS וכד'.
·        היכרות עם ספקים, קבלנים ומחירי שוק.
·        Excel ברמה גבוהה ואנגלית מקצועית טובה מאוד.
יתרון משמעותי
: ניסיון בחברת EPC, עבודה מול ספקים בינלאומיים, תמחור תחנות משנה/HV/MV, AutoCAD, PVsyst, ניסיון בחוזי EPC והבנת תנאים מסחריים כגון warranties, LDs, payment milestones ו־performance guarantees.

jobs.snippet:
Ottopia Defense | Systems & Operations
Ottopia Defense, part of Ondas, develops teleoperation and Hybrid AI technology for ground vehicles in defense applications. The Systems & Operations department turns this technology into integrated systems that can be deployed, supported, and reproduced.
This role will involve turning hardware and software components into working vehicle and operator systems within the systems engineering team. You will own integration, troubleshooting, and verification, with reproducible configurations and clear handover to system QA and delivery.
What you’ll do
Integrate computing, power, communications, sensors, and vehicle interfaces on the bench and in the field.
Translate system requirements and complex integrations into practical setups and designs.
Isolate and detect faults using measurements, logs and configuration evidence, and verify corrective actions.
Execute integration checks with system QA vectors, record results, and conduct performance research with the responsible engineering teams.
Maintain systems and setup documentation, manufacturing and engineering docs. BOM inputs and controlled hardware and software configurations.
Work with the systems team lead, SW R&D, operations and delivery to prepare repeatable builds and handovers.
What you bring
Practical experience integrating and troubleshooting physical systems that combine hardware and software.
Working understanding of electrical interfaces, computing and networks, with depth in a relevant area.
Ability to read technical diagrams and use measurements to test a diagnosis.
Experience documenting configurations, test results, and issues clearly for others to reproduce.
Clear communication in English and effective collaboration across engineering and operational teams.
How you work matters
We value ownership, integrity, and independent learning. Bring ideas, take responsibility and grow through feedback and shared work. Curiosity, sustained achievement and interests beyond work can add perspective; helping the team succeed is central.
Own commitments, follow issues through and raise risks early.
Learn independently, test assumptions and welcome constructive challenge.
Share knowledge, support colleagues and put the shared result first.
Connect your work to the wider system and act responsibly when priorities change.
Set high standards, show sustained achievement and seek broader responsibility.
An advantage
Experience with vehicles, robotics, embedded systems, rugged hardware or field integration. A relevant engineering degree or practical engineering qualification is an advantage.

jobs.snippet:
Who We Are
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
What We Offer
Location:
Kiryat Gat,ISR
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.
J
Job Description
We are looking for a highly talented customer engineer to join our account team & integrate within our field support group in
Kiryat Gat
to provide a unique customer experience by demonstrating outstanding technical capabilities and inter-personal skills.
What’s in it for you?
As a customer engineer at Applied Materials you’ll be working for a high growth international company, integrating into the heart of the manufacturing process of advanced digital devices. You’ll get the opportunity and practice to work on the most advanced semiconductor equipment while learning new skills or perfecting existing ones such as advanced trouble shooting and problem solving, project management, robotics, semiconductor device manufacturing processes and more. In addition, you’ll get advanced training on cutting edge hardware industry components.
Role Responsibilities:
Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] in installing, maintaining, and upgrading customer equipment
Use digital analytics for troubleshooting
Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with guidance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems (training provided)
Coordinate and communicate directly with customers
Fulfill additional duties, as assigned
Minimum Qualifications:
B.Sc. or Practical Engineer in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering , field service experience, or trade certification
Willing to learn and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics
Experience diagnosing and resolving basic technical challenges
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint

jobs.snippet:
About the company
ATOM develops an AI-based QA/QC platform for buildings in the early stages of construction. Our camera systems already operate on cranes and capture site data for analysis.
We need a hands-on systems engineer to improve, expand, and strengthen these systems. You will work on the complete system: cameras, sensors, power, communications, and software integration.
What you will do
Further develop our existing camera system and integrate optics, positioning sensors, power, and communications.
Make systems reliable in heat, rain, dust, wind, and vibration.
Work with technical partners to develop, build, and test solutions in the lab and on cranes.
Write basic code to control devices, collect data, and run tests.
Improve image quality, positioning accuracy, reliability, and cost.
Prepare systems for easier manufacturing, installation, and maintenance.
What you need
Experience developing and integrating hardware systems that work outside the lab.
Strong systems thinking and hands-on troubleshooting skills.
Working knowledge of cameras and optics, including lenses, image quality, and lighting.
Basic coding skills, preferably Python, for testing and hardware integration.
Knowledge of electrical systems, networking, and communications.
Understanding of environmental effects on hardware and system performance.
Ability to work independently and take responsibility for the complete system.
An advantage
Experience with GNSS, RTK, IMU, robotics, or mechatronics.
Experience with camera calibration, embedded systems, or design for manufacturing.

jobs.snippet:
אנחנו מגייסים – מהנדס/ת או הנדסאי/ת בקרה ואינטגרציית שטח!
חברת BLEnergy היא חברה מובילה בתחום אגירת האנרגיה בישראל ובחו"ל.
התפקיד כולל עבודה מעשית בשטח (Hands-on), הטמעה והרצה של מערכות בקרה, בדיקות תקשורת ואינטגרציה, ואיתור ופתרון תקלות בסביבה טכנולוגית מתקדמת.
**תחומי אחריות**
-        התקנה, הטמעה והרצה (Commissioning) של תוכנות ומערכות בקרה באתרי פרויקטים
-        ביצוע בדיקות אינטגרציה ותקשורת מול חיישנים, רכיבי קצה וציוד היקפי
-        איתור ופתרון תקלות חומרה, תוכנה ותקשורת בזמן אמת
-        עבודה שוטפת מול צוותי הפיתוח וההנדסה בחברה
-        הובלת תהליכי אינטגרציה והתקנה בפרויקטים בארץ ובחו"ל
**דרישות התפקיד**
-        תואר מהנדס/ת או דיפלומת הנדסאי/ת בחשמל, אלקטרוניקה או תוכנה – חובה
-        ניסיון באינטגרציה ופתרון תקלות במערכות משולבות חומרה ותוכנה – חובה
-        ניסיון בעבודה עם פרוטוקולי תקשורת תעשייתיים (Modbus, Ethernet, Serial) – חובה
-        אנגלית ברמה גבוהה – חובה
-        יכולת עבודה עצמאית, יוזמה ויחסי אנוש מצוינים
-        נכונות לנסיעות ולטיסות תכופות לחו"ל
-        ניסיון מעשי בעבודה בסביבת Linux, כולל Terminal, הגדרות רשת וניתוח לוגים
**כישורים אישיים**
-        עצמאות גבוהה, יוזמה ויכולת קבלת החלטות בשטח
-        נכונות לנסיעות ולטיסות תכופות לחו"ל בהתאם לצורכי הפרויקטים
-        תקשורת בינאישית מעולה ויחסי אנוש מצוינים בעבודה מול צוותים פנימיים ולקוחות
מיקום: עבודה משולבת במשרד ובאתרי פרויקטים בארץ ובחו"ל
היקף משרה: מלאה
הצטרפו אלינו והשפיעו על עתיד אגירת האנרגיה.

jobs.snippet:
Who We Are
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
What We Offer
Location:
Kiryat Gat,ISR
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
We are looking for a talented
customer support technician
to join our account team & integrate within our field support group in
Kiryat Gat
to provide a unique customer experience by demonstrating outstanding technical capabilities and inter-personal skills.
What’s in it for you?
As a customer support technician at Applied Materials you’ll be working for a high growth international company, integrating into the heart of the manufacturing process of advanced digital devices. You’ll get the opportunity and practice to work on the most advanced semiconductor equipment while learning new skills or perfecting existing ones such as advanced trouble shooting and problem solving, project management, robotics, semiconductor device manufacturing processes and more. In addition, you’ll get advanced training on cutting edge hardware industry components.
Role Responsibilities:
Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] in installing, maintaining, and upgrading customer equipment
Use digital analytics for troubleshooting
Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with guidance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems (training provided)
Coordinate and communicate directly with customers
Fulfill additional duties, as assigned
Minimum Qualifications:
Practical Engineer or Tecnician in Electrical Engineering or Mechatronics or mecanical
Willing to learn and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics
Experience diagnosing and resolving basic technical challenges
Fluent in English
Willing to travel -30%
Has a valid passport
Preferred Qualifications:
1–2 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field
Experience with electronic / mechanic equipment – advantage
Work is located in Kiryat Gat in a cleanroom environment
Work in shifts including nights and weekends
Physical Requirements:
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools. Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.
Additional Information
Time Type:
Full time
Employee Type:
Assignee / Regular
Travel:
Yes, 25% of the Time
Relocation Eligible:
No
Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

jobs.snippet:
Regulus is an agile defense-tech startup tackling the most complex challenges in counter-drone and uncrewed defense. With hundreds of combat-proven systems deployed by the IDF and global partners, we are now engineering the next generation of C-UxS (Counter-Uncrewed Systems). We leverage advanced electronic warfare and kinetic measures to detect and neutralize hostile threats. If you want to push technological boundaries while safeguarding Israel and our allies, join us at this pivotal stage of our growth.
This is a unique opportunity to join a company at a pivotal growth stage and help shape its products, culture, and future.
We are seeking a highly technical, hands-on
Advanced Drone R&D Engineer
to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for researching, assembling, and testing advanced drone technologies.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct in-depth research on drone hardware, datalinks, radios, and RF protocols (including ELRS, LoRa, and DJI systems).
Research and evaluate RF jamming techniques, spoofing, and anti-jamming solutions.
Assemble, wire, and integrate various drone components, payloads, and Linux-based companion computers using TCP/IP networking.
Configure and test multi-constellation GNSS systems, including RTK setups and satellite tracking optimization.
Perform precise soldering, wiring, and electronic troubleshooting in a lab environment.
Write clear, detailed technical reports on research findings, assembly procedures, and test results for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Requirements:
Strong understanding of drone flight controllers, datalinks, radios, and RF protocols
Familiarity with link budgets, antenna gain, signal attenuation, and GNSS/GPS tracking (ephemeris, cold starts).
Proficiency in Linux (command line) and TCP/IP networking.
Proven experience in drone assembly, including the ability to solder and work with small electronic components.
Excellent written communication skills with the ability to produce clear and concise technical reports.
Demonstrated ability to fly multirotor and/or fixed-wing drones - Advantage

jobs.snippet:
IT Operations Specialist | Entry-Level Opportunity
Looking to start your career in IT? Your technical background could be your first step into IT Operations!
A leading organization in Central Israel is looking for a motivated
IT Operations Specialist
to join its technology operations team.
This is an excellent opportunity for candidates with a technical background from academic studies, professional training, or military service who want to gain hands-on experience working with IT systems, infrastructure, and enterprise technology environments.
Previous professional IT experience is not required.
We're looking for candidates with a solid technical foundation, strong problem-solving abilities, and a genuine interest in developing a career in IT Operations.
What You'll Do
Monitor and support the daily operation of IT systems and services.
Track system availability, operational processes, and infrastructure performance.
Identify technical issues, perform initial troubleshooting, and escalate incidents when needed.
Work with operating systems, servers, and monitoring tools.
Document technical incidents, service requests, and operational activities.
Collaborate with System, Networking, Infrastructure, and Information Security teams.
Perform routine IT operational tasks according to established procedures.
Learn new technologies, tools, and enterprise systems as part of the role.
Requirements
Relevant technical background from academic studies, professional training, or military service.
Basic familiarity with operating systems and IT environments.
Technical orientation and basic troubleshooting abilities.
Strong motivation to begin or develop a career in IT.
Ability to learn independently and adapt quickly to new technologies.
Organized, systematic, and detail-oriented working approach.
Strong personal responsibility and teamwork skills.
Good interpersonal communication and customer service mindset.
Advantages
Professional training or certification in System Administration, Networking, or IT.
Familiarity with Windows and Linux operating systems.
Basic knowledge of Active Directory.
Understanding of fundamental computer networking concepts.
Familiarity with IT monitoring tools.
Relevant technical experience gained during military service.
Position Details
Location:
Central Israel
Employment Type:
Full-time
Experience Level:
Entry-level – No previous professional IT experience required.
If you're technically curious, enjoy solving problems, and want to build your career in IT infrastructure and operations, we'd love to hear from you!

jobs.snippet:
About Xerox Holdings Corporation
For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client-centric and digitally-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients. At Xerox, we make work, work. Learn more about us at www.xerox.com.
Overview:
Join Xerox as a Field Service Technician and become part of a growing Technical Services organization focused on delivering an exceptional customer experience. In this hands-on role, you will use your electro-mechanical expertise to troubleshoot, repair, and maintain customer equipment while helping maximize device availability and performance. Xerox provides technical training to help you build the product knowledge and skills needed to successfully support your assigned territory.
Why Join This Team:
Receive technical training from certified instructors through online and instructor-led learning
Build your expertise in electro-mechanical troubleshooting and equipment repair
Access career development and growth opportunities within Technical Services
Receive comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, wellness credits, and a company contribution to a Health Savings Account
Participate in a 401(k) program with company matching
Receive paid time off, holidays, and personal days
What You Will Do:
Diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain customer equipment using electrical and mechanical knowledge
Deliver professional, responsive customer service while helping minimize equipment downtime
Use diagnostic tools, including a multimeter, and interpret electrical schematics to identify and resolve equipment issues
Manage assigned service calls and territory responsibilities while meeting established productivity, response time, quality, and cost expectations
Maintain the equipment, parts, and inventory required to effectively support customers within your assigned territory
What You Need to Succeed
:
Electro-mechanical troubleshooting experience with the ability to use a multimeter and interpret electrical schematics
Strong customer service, time management, problem-solving, and organizational skills
Ability to work independently in a field-based environment while reliably meeting customer and service commitments
Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and regularly walk, stand, squat, bend, and drive for more than 50 percent of the workday
This position requires a valid driver's license, current automobile insurance coverage meeting company-specified minimums, and the ability to meet the company's motor vehicle safety standards.
How We Set You Up for Success:
Structured new-hire and technical training designed to prepare you for independent field service work
Training on Xerox equipment, troubleshooting procedures, inventory requirements, and customer service expectations
Clear expectations regarding service call volume, territory responsibilities, and customer satisfaction
Hands-on preparation to independently complete service calls accurately and efficiently
Supportive and collaborative environment with opportunities for continued career development

• ייזום ופיתוח פרויקטים שונים, לטובת קידום וחדשנות במעבדה.
• קיום קשר מקצועי רציף עם הצוות האקדמי.
• אחריות לנושא הבטיחות במעבדה.
• ביצוע מטלות נוספות ככל שיידרש.
דרישות התפקיד
• הנדסאי/ת / מהנדס/ת בתחומי אלקטרוניקה/מחשבים/מכטרוניקה, או תחום רלוונטי אחר. תואר ראשון בפיזיקה - יתרון.• ניסיון בעבודת מעבדה הכוללת הכרות ותפעול של צב"ד, ציוד מתקדם אלקטרוני ומכני ועזרי הוראה מגוונים.
• ניסיון בתפעול מערכות ממוחשבות ועבודה בסביבה ממוחשבת.
• יכולת זיהוי, ניתוח ופתרון תקלות ובעיות טכניות.
• יכולות ניהול פרויקטים מעבדתיים - הבנת הצורך, מחקר, אפיון, יישום והטמעה.
• יכולות פיתוח באלקטרוניקה ואלקטרו מכניקה.
• הכרות ויכולות פיתוח בשפות תכנות – PYTHON , C++ ועוד - יתרון.
• הכרות טובה עם חיישנים ותחום ה IOT - יתרון.
• ידיעת השפה העברית על בוריה וידיעת השפה האנגלית ברמה טובה מאד.
• יכולת למידה עצמית של תפעול ציוד חדש ומורכב, ויכולת התעדכנות מקצועית.
• יכולת עבודה עצמאית והשתלבות בצוות.
• יכולת התמודדות עם עומס משימות ולחץ.
• יכולות הדרכה.
• יצירתיות, יוזמה, יכולת הנעת תהליכים.
• תודעת שירות גבוהה ויחסי אנוש מעולים.
הערה: נדרשת נכונות לעבודה בשעות נוספות בהתאם לצורך, ובימי שישי (מס' פעמים במהלך שנת הלימודים).

jobs.snippet:
Landa is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented student to join our R&D Ink team and support the development, testing, and characterization of inks used in Nanography technology. The role combines hands-on laboratory work with ink performance evaluation, supporting the release of new ink generations and continuous improvement of existing products.
Responsibilities:
Perform ink testing on Nanography laboratory systems and jigs.
Conduct print-quality and printing-characterization analyses.
Monitor and evaluate ink physical properties.
Requirements:
2nd- to 3rd-year students in Chemistry, Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Electronics Engineering, or Practical Engineering students (Chemistry, Mechanical, or Electronics).
Availability to work 2-3 days per week (approximately 20-25 hours weekly).
Strong hands-on laboratory skills.
High attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to quickly learn procedures and follow instructions.
Ability to work effectively within a team and under demanding timelines.
Positive attitude and hands-on approach.
Fast learner with a strong desire to deepen technical knowledge.
Self-motivated and independent.
