jobs.snippet:
Job Details
Job Description:
The Role and Impact
As a Manufacturing Technician, you will play a vital role in our high-volume production process by operating, monitoring, and maintaining advanced equipment to ensure efficiency and quality standards are met. You'll have hands-on involvement in troubleshooting and optimizing tools, conducting quality checks, and ensuring the seamless assembly of products. Your efforts will directly contribute to producing top-tier products that drive Intel's success in the technology industry.
Business Group
Join Intel Corporation, a global leader in semiconductor innovation, where you will be part of a dynamic team dedicated to advancing manufacturing excellence. Our team collaborates to deliver high-quality products that empower progress and innovation worldwide. We operate in fast-paced environments, leveraging cutting-edge processes and technologies that support Intel's broader mission of shaping the future of computing and connectivity.
Key Responsibilities
Operate, monitor, and maintain advanced manufacturing equipment to achieve output targets.
Conduct online equipment adjustments and optimize processes to maintain production efficiency.
Perform quality control evaluations on raw materials and finished products to ensure compliance with industry standards.
Troubleshoot and resolve nonstandard events in the production line to ensure stable operations.
Collaborate with the Manufacturing Operations Manager and team peers to meet production schedules and escalate risks when necessary.
Support installation, qualification, and maintenance of new or reused production equipment.
Maintain accurate production logs and required documentation per Standard Operating Procedures.
Drive cost and quality improvements and assist in incorporating process enhancements.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
Practical Engineer in a relevant technical field such as Electronics, Mechatronics, Mechanical, or Hardware Engineering with hands-on experience gained through internships, academic projects, coursework, or hands-on training.
Proficiency in technical English to interpret manuals, document logs, and communicate effectively.
Ability to work in a demanding 12-hour shift schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
Preferred Qualifications
Relevant technical experience in a semiconductor cleanroom environment (FAB/SORT).
Hands-on expertise in operating, maintaining, or troubleshooting manufacturing equipment.
Familiarity with data-driven systems for tool monitoring and online adjustments.
Your contributions will be instrumental in shaping the success of our manufacturing processes. We encourage you to bring your enthusiasm, technical skills, and dedication to this exciting opportunity to grow with Intel.
Job Type
Experienced Hire
Shift
Shift 1 C (Israel)
Primary Location:
Israel, Kiryat-Gat
Additional Locations:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance.

N/A

This role will require an on-site presence. * Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change.

About the Job
Khasin On Time LTD is looking for skilled and motivated technical non-professionals to join our team specializing in elevator and escalator modernization.
We especially encourage Russian-speaking professionals with hands-on technical experience to apply! We welcome candidates from various technical backgrounds, including mechanics, electrical work, electronics, equipment repair, and industrial maintenance.No previous experience with elevators or escalators is required!
We provide full professional training at the company's expense.
Key Responsibilities:
Participate in elevator and escalator modernization projects.
Replace, upgrade, and install mechanical and electrical components.
Perform technical work in accordance with established quality and safety standards.
Diagnose technical issues and assist in troubleshooting.
Work alongside an experienced team of technical professionals.
Requirements:
Israeli citizenship is mandatory.
Practical experience in mechanics, electrical systems, electronics, equipment repair, industrial maintenance, or related technical fields.
Strong technical aptitude and hands-on experience with tools.
Ability and willingness to learn new technologies and equipment.
Responsible, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a team.
Russian and/or Hebrew communication skills for professional interaction.
Experience with elevators or escalators is an advantage but NOT required.
What We Offer:
Competitive salary.
Full professional training paid for by the company.
Company vehicle for eligible candidates.
Stable, long-term, full-time employment.
Professional development and career growth opportunities.
Hands-on experience with modern technical equipment.
Supportive and professional working environment.
Preferred Locations: We especially welcome candidates living in: Rishon LeZion, Rehovot, Ramla, Ness Ziona, Yavne, Bat Yam, and surrounding areas in Central Israel.
Interested in Joining Our Team?
If you are an Israeli citizen, speak Russian and/or Hebrew, have a technical background, and are looking for a stable career opportunity, we would love to hear from you!
Apply through LinkedIn and take the next step in your technical career. Company Website: www.dragnoa.com
